enrichment-abilities.json.name: Icon of Khorne
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Wargear ability (shared by units with an Icon of Khorne, e.g. Khorne Berzerkers): each enemy unit the bearer's unit destroys banks 1 Bloodshed point; every Blessings of Khorne roll adds one rolled D6 per banked point, then all Bloodshed points are lost.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Idol of Blessed Blood
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: At the start of the battle round, while this model is on the battlefield, one additional (rolled) D6 is added to your Blessings of Khorne roll.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Punishing Suppression
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: MONSTER and VEHICLE units cannot be suppressed.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Bloodied Terror
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] the test subtracts 1 if the enemy unit is Below Half-strength

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Frenzy
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Once per turn, per unit. In the Fight phase, after an enemy unit that targeted this unit resolves its attacks, this unit is eligible to fight again and must be selected to fight next.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Super-heavy War Engine
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: community-authored provisional 11e; mirrors the Imperial Knights Super-heavy Walker mechanic on the Khorne Lord of Skulls.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: The Scent of Blood
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In the Charge phase when this unit declares a charge: +1 to charge rolls if an enemy unit below starting strength is within 9", or +2 if an enemy unit below half strength is within 9". (Enemy-strength predicate carried on the option modifier; no dedicated condition type exists.)

effect.choice_label: Shoot at or charge the arriving unit

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Bloody Stampede
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model when its unit ends a Charge move

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Crush All Who Stand Before Us
Brazen Fury
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit was destroyed, the unit can make a D6" Brazen Fury surge move.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Wrath of Khorne
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Only the unit's CHARACTER models' melee attacks gain the chosen benefit; modeled unit-wide.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blood Tithe
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Earn side: 1 BTP on a 3+ each time an enemy unit is destroyed by a Blood Legions/World Eaters unit. Spend side (start of your Command phase, effects last until end of battle) references the four detachment abilities by id: enraged-abjuration (2), daemonic-rage (3), boon-of-blood (4), might-of-khorne (5).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Enraged Abjuration
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Applies to BLOOD LEGIONS and WORLD EATERS models only; modeled as all friendly units (keyword-OR gate not expressible). Blood Tithe spend (2 BTP): the start-of-Command-phase activation timing and until-end-of-battle duration come from the parent Blood Tithe rule ('At the start of the Command phase, you can spend... to activate one of the following abilities until the end of the battle'), not from this option's own text.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Daemonic Rage
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Blood Tithe spend (3 BTP), activated at the start of your Command phase, lasting until end of battle: melee weapons equipped by Blood Legions units gain [LANCE].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Boon of Blood
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Blood Tithe spend (4 BTP), activated at the start of your Command phase, lasting until end of battle: Blood Legions units have a 4+ invulnerable save. Referenced by blessing-of-burning-blood as the 'Boon of Blood active' condition.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Might of Khorne
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Blood Tithe spend (5 BTP), activated at the start of your Command phase, lasting until end of battle: Blood Legions units gain the Blessings of Khorne ability.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Idols of Khorne
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The aura reaches 9" from TITANIC bearers (modeled at the 6" base), and each Idol may only be selected once per battle (per-option limit not modeled).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Berzerker Glaive
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: excludes Extra Attacks weapons

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Favoured of Khorne
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Modeled as re-rolling the Blessings of Khorne roll while the bearer is on the battlefield; the cap of re-rolling only up to two of the D6 is not modeled (upper bound).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Butcher Lord
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] may only be attached to a JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Strategic Slaughter
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: After both players deploy, redeploy up to three JAKHALS and/or GOREMONGERS units; they may be set up in Strategic Reserves regardless of Reserves limits.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Unleash Hell
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The suppressed unit must have been hit by the selected vehicle's attacks and the vehicle is chosen within 6" of the bearer (or is its transport); the hit-gate and the 6" pick are not modeled.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Disciple of Khorne
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] may only be attached to a BLOODCRUSHERS or FLESH HOUNDS unit; the BLOOD LEGIONS Faction keyword replaces WORLD EATERS while leading

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blade of Endless Bloodshed
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Melee weapons get +1 A/S/D; each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit in melee you automatically gain 1 Blood Tithe point (no 3+ roll needed).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Malicious Vigour
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Each Brazen Fury move made by the bearer's unit counts as having rolled a 6 for its distance.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Archslaughterer
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: WORLD EATERS model only. Once per battle, per army, in your Command phase: every Blessing of Khorne is active for this unit until the start of your next turn.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Gateways to Glory
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: WORLD EATERS DAEMON PRINCE model only: the bearer has MOBILE and adds 1 to Charge rolls.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hack and Slash
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The unit must have made a Charge move this turn and must not yet have been selected to fight this phase; both preconditions are left out of the effect tree so the stratagem stays a toggleable lever for the cruncher.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Frenzied Resilience
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: reactive: used just after an enemy unit selects your unit as a target in the Fight phase

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blood Offering
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: the objective marker remains yours until your opponent's Level of Control over it exceeds yours at the end of a phase; usable even though the unit was just destroyed

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne!
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: used just after your unit destroys a CHARACTER or MONSTER model; the extra Blessing is active in addition to any currently active Blessings

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Berzerker's Wrath
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: replaces the D6 surge-move roll: models move up to 8" instead

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Bloodthirsty Horde
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Targets one JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit that has not been selected to fight this phase and is within Engagement Range (the keyword-OR target and the not-yet-fought precondition are not modeled).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Bloody Vengeance
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The marked unit must be the enemy unit that just destroyed your MONSTER/TITANIC (modeled as selecting one enemy unit).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Brazen Idol
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The selected Idol is active for this unit instead of any other active Idol and may repeat an already-used Idol; the grant_type slugs are display labels for the three Idols of Khorne auras (see idols-of-khorne), not ability_id references.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: In the Shadow of Brass Idols
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] the 5+ also applies within 9" of a friendly WORLD EATERS TITANIC unit; usable in your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects your JAKHALS or GOREMONGERS unit as a target

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Endless Pursuit of Violence
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The unit must be WHOLLY within 6" of the selected transport (modeled as within 6"), and the transport must be one it is able to embark within.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Aggressive Disembarkation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The Rhino must not have been selected to move this phase (precondition not modeled). The disembarking unit sets up wholly within 6" of the Rhino and may be placed within Engagement Range.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Unrelenting Advance
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: cannot be combined with the Fury Unleashed Stratagem in the same phase

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Fury Unleashed
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] used just after an enemy unit shoots a WORLD EATERS RHINO with wounds remaining: one embarked KHORNE BERZERKERS unit makes the disembark move then the surge move; cannot be combined with Unrelenting Advance in the same phase

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blessing of Burning Blood
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: 5+ invulnerable save until end of phase, improving to 4+ while the Boon of Blood ability (Blood Tithe, Khorne Daemonkin) is active. The source targets a Blood Legions unit within 6" of the attacked World Eaters unit but buffs that World Eaters unit; the DSL target vocabulary can't express that relay, so target is the unit the ability resolves on.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: A Worthy Skull
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The follow-on 'spend one or more BTP to activate one of the Blood Tithe abilities' is modeled as an unquantified resource-spend without naming the activated ability.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Summoned by Slaughter
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Set up a Bloodletters unit from Reserves wholly within 9" of the destroyed model and more than 6" from enemy units, once per battle round. Modeled with resurrection — the local blood-legions summon pattern (cf. daemontide); the Reserves origin, 9"/>6" placement, and once-per-battle-round limit are recorded here rather than in the effect shape.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Daemontide
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Destroyed CHARACTER models cannot be returned to Attached units (restriction not modeled). Returned models go to one BLOOD LEGIONS unit within 6" of the stratagem's target.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Murder-call
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: the unit must be on the battlefield and not within Engagement Range of enemy units

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Daemonic Strength
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] EIGHTBOUND get the bonus against targets that are not MONSTERS or VEHICLES; EXALTED EIGHTBOUND get it against MONSTERS and VEHICLES instead

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Daemonic Resistance
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Defensive: each time an attack targets the unit, subtract 1 from the attacker's Wound roll (modeled attacker-side, as icon-of-obstinacy / rugged-resilience do). Reactive stratagem, used just after an enemy selects targets in the opponent's Shooting or Fight phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Immortal Fury
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: used just after an enemy unit selects your unit as a target; only models that have not fought this phase fight after the attacking unit finishes its attacks

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Warp Stalkers
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Move-through excludes enemy MONSTER and VEHICLE models, and a Charge move may end within Engagement Range (both nuances not modeled). Applies to Normal, Advance, Fall Back and Charge moves; the unit must not have been selected to move or declare a charge this phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Aspire to Infamy
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Only the unit's CHARACTER models' melee attacks gain +1 A / +2 S; modeled unit-wide.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Punish the Craven
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: An enemy unit engaged with your WORLD EATERS CHARACTER that falls back must use desperate escape; if it is battle-shocked, -1 to those hazard rolls.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Rampaging Terrors
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] The same enemy unit cannot be selected for this effect more than once per phase (cap not modeled). Grants friendly DAEMON VEHICLE units the Terror of Khorne ability; BRAZEN ENGINES is an onslaught detachment and cannot be combined with another onslaught detachment.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Talons of Butchery
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: MAULERFIEND unit only. This unit's Maulerfiend Fists have [CLEAVE 2].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Murder-Forged Entity
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: WORLD EATERS VEHICLE model only: the unit gains the DAEMON keyword.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Goaded to Fury
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: When an enemy unit that targeted a friendly unengaged DAEMON VEHICLE (excluding TITANIC) has shot, that unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Adamantine Avalanche
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: At the start of the Fight phase, if a friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD is engaged, make a Blessings of Khorne roll and activate one Blessing of Khorne for friendly TERMINATOR SQUAD units (in addition to any already active).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Gore-Stained Veterans
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: +1 Weapon Skill on melee attacks, modeled as a WS characteristic modifier (distinct from +1 to Hit; the two stack and must not collide under the single +1-to-Hit cap).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Wrath Beyond Reason
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: lasts until the attacking enemy unit has finished its attacks

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Scorn the Witch
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER (excluding EPIC HERO) gains Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds when it suffers a mortal wound.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Blood Surge (Once per turn, per unit)
